rolefit_input.job_description:
Product Data Analyst

Join the Growth Analytics team to turn product and customer data into clear decisions. You will partner with product managers and engineers, design experiments, and build trusted reporting for the product organization.

Basic Qualifications
- 3+ years of product or business data-analysis experience.
- Advanced SQL and working knowledge of Python for analysis.
- Experience designing and analyzing A/B tests.
- Experience building and maintaining Tableau dashboards.
- Clear communication and collaboration with product and engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with Apache Airflow.
- Experience with dbt.
